smixs-skill-conductor-skill-conductor.description: Create, edit, evaluate, and package agent skills. Use when building a new skill from scratch, improving an existing skill, fixing a skill that never triggers or fires unreliably, running evals to test a skill, benchmarking skill performance, optimizing a skill's description, reviewing third-party skills for quality, or packaging skills for distribution — even if the user doesn't explicitly say "skill" (e.g. "teach Claude to do X", "make the agent always follow Y"). Not for using skills or general coding tasks.
